video_title: What the Hall of Fame Means to Doc Rivers | Andscape

quotes.speaker: Doc Rivers
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers on the Hall of Fame selection process
quotes.excerpt: they tell you a time period. Like, hey, the Hall is going to call between 9 and 11.
quotes.quote: So funny, Marc, because they tell you a time period. Like, hey, the Hall is going to call between 9 and 11. That call doesn't mean it's a good call. But 9:15, I get a text and it was like, hey Doc, we've tried to call you twice, but you haven't picked up the phone. And I didn't realize, because I'm old, that I have my phone blocked to unidentified numbers. And obviously, I don't have Hall of Fame saved on my phone.

quotes.speaker: Doc Rivers
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers on the prestige of being a Hall of Fame coach
quotes.excerpt: college coaches get to coach and be called Hall of Fame coach, where NBA coaches rarely get that.
quotes.quote: I wanted to get in while I was still coaching and I achieved that. I really fought early on for Pop, Steve Kerr, Spo, myself. I just think college coaches get to coach and be called Hall of Fame coach, where NBA coaches rarely get that.

quotes.speaker: Doc Rivers
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers' evaluation of Rajon Rondo as a future coach
quotes.excerpt: I think Rajon Rondo is going to be a hell of a coach.
quotes.quote: I think Rajon Rondo is going to be a hell of a coach. Now, he's a savant, and that a lot of times doesn't go well at times because he sees it. We talk about it all the time. He said, man, you're a hell of a point guard coach. I said, yeah, I was a good point guard. I wasn't a hell of a point guard. I was a solid point guard. And he's like, coach, you see it and they don't. How do you handle that? I said, you breathe. Because you learn patience.

quotes.speaker: Doc Rivers
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers on the importance of collective success
quotes.excerpt: part of the word in Ubuntu is that you don't live in isolation.
quotes.quote: Part of the word in Ubuntu is that you don't live in isolation. And that's what I teach. If you do anything in life, you didn't do it alone. So my speech should be more about the people who helped me get there and less about me. That's where I'm headed today. Or I may get up there like Snoop and say I want to thank me.
